component: memory-budgeted disk weight streaming: early-load MoE expert paging (load before materialization) and dense quantized MLP projection paging
source_repository: design inputs only; no peer code copied

sources.used: idea only: exact expert bytes, explicit resident/streamed memory tiers and a boot budget. Its CPU mmap trunk and router truncation were NOT adopted.
idea only: replace expert modules before model materialization; loader-thread ownership; settings refuse unsupported speculative combinations.
idea only: lazy load, wrap selected layers, then evaluate only the resident trunk; byte-based budget partitioning. Prefetch, pinning and resident-layer policies were NOT adopted.

modifications: All code is original to mlx2 and extends its own runtime/weight_stream.py (2026-09 expert streaming).
Source addressing is proven by raw-array object identity through sanitize, or by an explicitly ledgered output-axis concatenation; any other transform is refused.

Shard descriptors and safetensors headers are bound at construction from the adapter's indexed weight map and identity records; reads re-check an fstat tuple (a mutation detector, not a content hash).
Cache entries are concrete; host staging is bounded by materializing as reads complete; a worst-case per-layer gather transient is reserved beside the steady cache.
Dense paging replaces trunk MLP QuantizedLinear modules with plain modules that run the stock quantized_matmul and evaluate the output before releasing the projection.

North Mini Code declares the existing generic moe_experts early-load contract on its concrete adapter; its already-stacked checkpoint tables are source-resolved before materialization, stock expert arithmetic is forced, external drafting is refused under an unproven combined weight budget, and route diagnostics keep eligibility, selection and observed page-ins distinct.

The source-origin protocol now records an exact axis-0 stack of individually indexed per-expert tensors. Every selected expert remains bound to its own immutable checkpoint byte range; transformed parts, other axes, mixed shapes and mixed dtypes fail closed.

North Mini Code and Xing4.0 declare the existing generic moe_experts early-load contract on their concrete adapters. Both force stock expert arithmetic, keep the policy default-off, and leave selection and observed-use authority with the server receipt. Xing can keep its embedded MTP experts resident through the existing explicit mtp_resident policy.

Predictive cross-layer prefetch was not enabled: the repository already records a negative end-to-end result and the new adapters have no revision-bound predictor. Reactive router-known parallel page-in remains exact and unchanged.

Mellum 2.1 declares the same generic early expert stream. Its ordinary eager layer-at-a-time stack remains unchanged; only the selected streamed load uses the exact stack-origin ledger, and its 64-expert top-8 route stays default-off and server-receipted.
